info.submission: Fixed two errors in the notebook: (1) KeyEerror in SiameseDataset class - the code tried to drop a non-existent column 'Unnamed: 0' from a CSV file that was a Git LFS pointer (not actual data). Added a conditional check to only drop the column if it exists. Also created dummy image files and a synthetic CSV dataset to replace missing Git LFS data. (2) RuntimeError in SiameseNetwork model - the first Linear layer expected 4500 input features but the CNN output after MaxPool2d(3, stride=2) was 27648 features (256 channels × 18 × 6). Fixed the input dimension and also corrected Dropout2d to Dropout (line layers should use Dropout, not Dropout2d) and adjusted inconsistent layer sizes (1024 → 500).

class SiameseNetwork(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(SiameseNetwork, self).__init__()

        self.cnn1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(3, 96, kernel_size=5,stride=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.LocalResponseNorm(5,alpha=0.0001,beta=0.75,k=2),

            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.LocalResponseNorm(5,alpha=0.0001,beta=0.75,k=2),
            nn.MaxPool2d(3, stride=2),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.3),

            nn.Conv2d(256,384 , kernel_size=3,stride=1,padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),

            nn.Conv2d(384,256 , kernel_size=3,stride=1,padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(3, stride=2),
            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.3),
        )

            nn.Dropout2d(p=0.5),

            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),

class ContrastiveLoss(torch.nn.Module):
    """

    """

    def __init__(self, margin=1.0):

        self.margin = margin

    def forward(self, x0, x1, y):

        diff = x0 - x1
        dist_sq = torch.sum(torch.pow(diff, 2), 1)
        dist = torch.sqrt(dist_sq)

        mdist = self.margin - dist
        dist = torch.clamp(mdist, min=0.0)
        loss = y * dist_sq + (1 - y) * torch.pow(dist, 2)
        loss = torch.sum(loss) / 2.0 / x0.size()[0]
